summary: The DFlash split-KV draft attention kernel runs on GB10 (DGX Spark) instead of being silently skipped
compatibility: No change on RTX PRO 6000. On GB10, VLLM_GLM53_DFLASH_ATTN=1 now takes effect.
details: The availability check required compute capability exactly 12.0; it now accepts the SM120 family, which includes GB10 (12.1). The kernel is compiled for the device's own architecture.
From #673 by original-el8: 40 kernel tests passed on GB10.
